map.输入需要区分的状态总数 N 与采用的进制，工具计算表示这些状态所需的最少位数（如: Enter the total number of states N to distinguish and the radix in use; the tool computes the minimum digits needed to represent them (for example 256 states need 2 hexadecimal digits), for encoding design.
map.状态编码：为有限状态机的状态数选最小进制位数。: State encoding: choose the smallest number of digits in a radix for the number of states of a finite state machine.
map.地址/索引规划：N 个单元在 b 进制下所需位数 ⌈log_b(N)⌉。: Address and index planning: the digits needed for N units in base b are ceil(log_b(N)).
map.表示对比：比较二进制/十六进制表达同一状态空间的紧凑度。: Representation comparison: compare how compactly binary and hexadecimal express the same state space.
map.最少位数 = ⌈log_b(N)⌉，N 为状态总数、b 为进制。: Minimum digits = ceil(log_b(N)), where N is the total number of states and b the base.
map.前者按\"状态数\"算覆盖所需位数，后者按\"某个具体数值\"算其表示长度。: The former counts the digits needed to cover the number of states; the latter counts the representation length of one specific value.
map.N≤1 记 1 位（单状态无需区分）。: Record N<=1 as 1 digit (a single state needs no distinction).
